Package com.eventlottery.model

Class AttendeeEventHistory

java.lang.Object
com.eventlottery.model.AttendeeEventHistory
public class AttendeeEventHistory extends Object
Represents the history of an attendee's participation in a specific event. Stores the unique identifier for the event and the attendance status.
